decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks build directly on the firm's core thermoforming and dental lab material know-how, so the firm can interpret lab feedback and keep refining the line, even though the lack of website visibility since 2020 adds some uncertainty.
PETG thermoforming blanks sit squarely within the firm's established material competence and in-house R&D, making them a low-risk core product that is easy to maintain and improve.

The intraoral contrast spray supports the firm's strategic shift to digital scanning workflows, but it lies further from its core materials knowledge and was not visible after 2019, so withdrawal risk is moderate.
Custom earmolds are a core competence of the hearing-care business, where skilled custom manufacturing and digital production let the firm absorb market feedback and keep improving the line.
Custom hearing protection uses the same earmold know-how and digital production in an adjacent market the firm understands, so it is worth keeping despite somewhat less certain demand.
